A '''Khormai village''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Khorm/Legends|Khorm]] was decimated during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] when the [[Khormai/Legends|Khormai]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Unger Gout]] unleashed the power of his [[weather-control station]] to stop the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] from reaching his base and stopping his [[Agrocite/Legends|agrocite]]-[[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] ring. When the [[Khormai resistance]] leader [[Adaroo]] discovered the village while leading a group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to Gout's location, he insisted on burying the [[Death/Legends|dead]] Khormai he found there before continuing.
